items.title: Asking for Directions – Everyday English Dialogues
items.description:
In this everyday English dialogue, you will learn common, natural-sounding vocabulary, expressions, pronunciation, and intonation to use the next time you need to ask for and/or give directions. You will also review prepositions of place and prepositions of direction in context.
